ck2_hint_mix: Stir in circles until the batter is smooth!
ck2_hint_bake: Take it out when the needle is in the green zone!
ck2_bake_ok: A little too long, but tasty.
ck2_hint_frost: Spread the frosting over the top and sides.
ck2_hint_decorate: Tap the top of the cake to add toppings.
ck2_result_1: Hmm, not quite what they ordered.
game_jigsaw_desc: Drag the pieces into place and complete colorful pictures. Choose 12, 24 or 40 pieces.
game_coloring_desc: Pick a color and tap to fill! 8 cute pictures, zoom in for small areas, undo and your work is saved.
co_hint: Tap an area to fill it. Pinch to zoom.
game_mine_run_desc: Ride the mine cart as fast as you can! Swipe to change tracks, jump over barrels, duck under beams and grab the gold.
rn_how: ← → change track · ↑ jump over barrels · ↓ duck under beams · avoid rocks!
game_pool_desc: Classic 8-ball pool with realistic physics. Aim, set the power and pot your group before the 8! Play the computer (3 levels) or a friend.
pl_rules: Pot all your balls (solids or stripes), then the 8. Fouls (white ball in a pocket, not hitting your own ball first) give your opponent ball in hand.
pl_foul: Foul! Ball in hand for the opponent.
pl_ball_in_hand: Ball in hand: drag the white ball where you like.
pl_hint: Drag on the table to aim, pull the power bar down and release to shoot.
game_animals_desc: For little ones: tap 12 cute animals to hear their names and sounds, then play the guessing game!
an_explore_desc: Tap the animals to hear their names and sounds.
an_quiz_desc: Listen to the question and find the right animal.
game_factory_desc: Build a production empire: mine ore, cut wood and grow cotton, turn them into iron, planks and fabric, then tools, furniture, clothes and cars. Watch market prices, fill orders and earn even while you're away!
fa_market_hint: Selling a lot at once lowers the price; it recovers over time. Keep the materials you need for your factories!
